WeatherPage:

              <cell row="1" col="1" colspan="2" halign="center" valign="center">
                <Paragraph name="AtmosphereSummary" color="#ffffff" font-size="18">Current sky and weather conditions with solar output and pedestrian settings</Paragraph>
              </cell>
              <cell row="2" col="1" colspan="1" halign="center" valign="center">
                <Paragraph color="#ffffff" font-size="18">Day and night change automatically.</Paragraph>
              </cell>
              <cell row="2" col="2" colspan="1" halign="center" valign="center">
                <Paragraph color="#ffffff" font-size="18">Sun, clouds and rain change automatically.</Paragraph>
              </cell>

                <Button name="PedestrianControl" width="320" height="36">

                  <text-caption color="#ffffff" font-size="18" halign="center" font-weight="bold">Show or hide people</text-caption>
                </Button>
              </cell>
              <cell row="4" col="1" colspan="2" halign="center" valign="center">
                <Paragraph name="ClockExplanation" color="#ffffff" font-size="18">The sun rises and sets by itself. Days last 8-16 minutes; nights last 3-6.</Paragraph>
              </cell>
              <cell row="5" col="1" colspan="2" halign="center" valign="center">
                <Paragraph name="SolarNote" color="#ffffff" font-size="18">Clouds make solar panels weaker. At night they make no power.</Paragraph>

            </TableLayout>
          </Panel>
